name: pedag
description: A language for programs that reason under uncertainty: probabilistic control flow, first-class tensors, capability security, provenance tracking, and contracts that generate their own tests.

scripts.examples: node bin/pedag.mjs run examples/quantum.pedag && node bin/pedag.mjs run examples/agents.pedag && node bin/pedag.mjs run examples/devices.pedag && node bin/pedag.mjs run examples/crypto.pedag --grant crypto
